description: Read-only: returns the published way to report a machine or payment problem (a machine that took money, stopped mid cycle or will not open), in English or Spanish: what to include, the email and phone, the response and refund lines as published, and the report page. It does NOT file, send or store a report.

language.description: Which language of the site to quote: "en" (default) or "es" (the Spanish pages, under /es/).

name: how_to_report_machine_issue
